# drive v1: mctas mobfarm siding-bench <design> --wired --launch --from 4 --to 4 --nights 1 --drive-out F (arrivals launched from rest on the bench's launcher; the release placed as a block: the loop's input)

# seed 4
# days 2
# walk random
# ai on
# start Run::start(spec, RunOpts { ai: true, ..RunOpts::steady(seed, days * 24000, WalkMode::Random) }); settle_tick until false; the design's entity lines spawned in order (eN: line N from 0, eN.pK: its passenger K from 0); t0 = the world's time then
